summary: Steele Creek Capital Corp filed an 8-K Item 8.01 Other Events to disclose that its Board of Directors declared a cash dividend of $0.1287 per share on its common stock, payable on July 15, 2026 to holders of record as of May 20, 2026. This is a routine distribution event, not a special situation. There are no terms involving a premium, advisor, or structural changes. No risk-arb angle or regulatory clock applies. The filing merely reports the dividend declaration and record/payment dates.
